subject.title: memory flush never triggers when reserveTokensFloor equals contextWindow

question: What should OpenClaw do when `reserveTokensFloor + memoryFlush.softThresholdTokens` leaves no positive token gate for the active context window?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the permanent behavior changes existing operator config semantics and overlaps with adjacent reserve and soft-threshold PRs, so automation should not pick the clamp, warning, validation, or doctor-migration policy alone.

options.title: Centralize Effective Threshold Clamp
options.body: Clamp only the derived runtime reserve or threshold, keep existing config files valid, and add tests/docs for the effective behavior.

options.title: Validate And Migrate Config
options.body: Reject or doctor-fix oversized reserve-floor settings so runtime only sees canonical values, with a clearer but heavier upgrade path.

options.title: Defer To Budget PR
options.body: Keep this issue open until an adjacent reserve or soft-threshold PR establishes the shared policy, then close or repair this issue against that policy.

recommendation.title: Centralize Effective Threshold Clamp
recommendation.body: Clamp only the derived runtime reserve or threshold, keep existing config files valid, and add tests/docs for the effective behavior.
